purpose: Audit section 28-C requires at least one non-Wikipedia, production-shaped revision source for Family B. This experiment adds US federal regulation (eCFR) as a second corpus family. It does not modify, reopen or reinterpret the sealed V03 result; V03 remains the evidence for its own declared English-Wikipedia section projection, and this experiment stands or falls on its own.
why_ecfr: Revision-shaped: every section carries an amendment_date and issue_date lineage through the versioner API.
Production-shaped: numbered hierarchical sections, defined terms, cross-references, dates and quantities -- the document shape TAVONEL actually targets, unlike prose encyclopedia articles.

Carries an INDEPENDENT external change label: each content_version record has a government-assigned `substantive` boolean. Wikipedia has no equivalent. This is the scientific reason to prefer eCFR over SEC filings for this round.
Public domain US government work; no licence barrier to storing derived artifacts.

external_ground_truth.assigned_by: eCFR publisher (US Government Publishing Office data)
external_ground_truth.meaning_false: the section was reissued without a substantive change
external_ground_truth.measured_before_freeze: For title 21 part 1, an identical section (1.71) reissued on 2023-03-30 against a 2022-11-17 amendment_date with substantive=false returned byte-identical XML (sha256 68b9aadf6dace6af..., 3338 bytes) at both dates. The label and the bytes agree on the case that was checked.
external_ground_truth.use_in_this_experiment: Reported alongside TAVONEL's own channel classification as an independent comparison. It is NOT used to select pairs, NOT used to tune anything, and NOT a pass gate -- see forbidden.

selection.pair_rule: For each part, take the two most recent distinct issue_date values that both resolve to retrievable section XML, oldest of the two as `before` and newest as `after`.

projection.unit: eCFR DIV8 SECTION element with normalized body length >= 120 characters
projection.identity: title + part + section number, with the live current-core logical identity resolver allowed to abstain
projection.document_shape: section number paths + block count + unit order
projection.artifacts: one section artifact per logical unit + one document index + deterministic four-bucket topic projections
projection.note: This mirrors the V03 projection contract with the heading hierarchy replaced by the eCFR section hierarchy. The evaluator itself is reused unchanged.

evaluator.reason: Reusing the sealed evaluator byte-for-byte is what makes this a corpus-family robustness test rather than a new method. Only the transport and the projection adapter are new.

reported_but_not_gated: agreement between TAVONEL semantic-channel detection and the eCFR substantive label
cases where substantive=false but TAVONEL saw a semantic change
cases where substantive=true but TAVONEL saw only locator/metadata changes

transport.user_agent: TAVONEL-research/1.0 (Family B regulatory robustness; contact via repository)

claim_boundary: A PASS here establishes that typed change-channel separation and selective recompilation hold on a second, non-Wikipedia, production-shaped revision family (US federal regulation) under the same sealed evaluator. It does NOT widen the V03 claim, does NOT establish a general work-avoided rate across corpora, and does NOT establish OCR, ontology or customer-data performance.
